title: Dynamic Markdown Strategies for Perishable Products: Waste Reduction versus Profitability
summary: Freshness is a key attribute of perishable goods, particularly in the food sector, and strongly influences consumer purchasing behavior. Retailers often prioritize high freshness to remain competitive, yet maintaining this standard under demand uncertainty increases the likelihood of unsold inventory and waste. Retailers use markdowns to mitigate this risk, but the timing and depth of discounts must be carefully coordinated to avoid lost revenue or excess waste. This paper studies how retailers can jointly optimize order and markdown pricing decisions to balance profitability and waste…
